title: Requalify changed heads without serializing external review and CI

rubric.text: Refuses stale H1 acceptance after head refresh; invalidates affected checks, independent/external reviews and dispositions without relabelling their provenance.
Keeps repairs with the original owner, renews affected checks and focused independent review including interactions, then starts external review without waiting for H2 CI.
Retains demonstrably compatible documentation evidence with its original head; accepts only after all final-head gates and authority qualify.
